definitions.explanation: The later part of the day, typically from after work/school until bedtime.

⟦{毎晩|まいばん}→毎晩：00967_maiban⟧⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}みます→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: I read a book every evening.
examples.notes: ⟦{毎晩|まいばん}→毎晩：00967_maiban⟧ = every evening/night

examples.english: Would you like to watch a movie tonight?

examples.english: It gets cooler in the evening, so I sleep with the window open.

notes:
{晩|ばん} refers to the evening or night, often emphasizing the social time after work or school.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{晩|ばん}ごはん→晩ご飯：02940_bangohan⟧/⟦{夕飯|ゆうはん}→夕飯：02981_yuuhan⟧: dinner
- ⟦{今晩|こんばん}→今晩：02882_konban⟧: tonight, this evening
- ⟦{毎晩|まいばん}→毎晩：00967_maiban⟧: every evening/night
- ⟦{昨晩|さくばん}→昨晩：10970_sakuban⟧: last night
- ⟦{一晩|ひとばん}→一晩：08887_hitoban⟧: one night, overnight

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {晩|ばん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become evening
- ⟦{一晩中|ひとばんじゅう}→一晩中：20338_hitobanjuu⟧: all night long
- ⟦{晩年|ばんねん}→晩年：27495_bannen⟧: one's later years

DISTINCTION FROM ⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧:
- {晩|ばん}: emphasizes the social evening period (dinner time, evening activities)
- ⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧: broader term for night, can include late night

Both can often be used interchangeably, but {晩|ばん} appears more in compounds related to daily activities.
